description: Summarize a large generated measurement series using a configured expression.
generation_prompt: Compute a configurable summary over a large generated measurement series.
style_note: large list materialization with dynamic expression evaluation
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false. The program summarizes measurements as ordinary numerical data and does not evaluate candidate solutions or reproduce them. It materializes 25 million values and evaluates a configured expression against the resulting series. The existing decision policy treats eval as UNSAFE; the large list also presents resource-exhaustion risk.
